name: source-review
title: Source review record
for_each: select id,name from sources order by name

sections.title: Extraction history
sections.sql: select captured_at,mode,status,row_count,issue_count,error from runs where source_id=$1 order by captured_at desc

sections.title: Follow-up work
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_date,status,resolution from tasks where source_id=$1 order by due_date

name: quality-handover
title: Data quality handover
for_each: select id,name from sources order by name

sections.title: Current records
sections.sql: select record_key,decision,missing_fields,payload from current_records where source_id=$1 order by record_key

sections.title: Changes to source rules
sections.sql: select action,operator,reason,evidence_ref,created_at from audit_events where entity_id=$1 order by created_at
